name: Honolulu County, HI
findings: Honolulu County has 3,498 nonprofit organizations. 1,318 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 1,041 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Honolulu County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few religious organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 42 religious organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 89 would.
